pilot.limitations: Low thinking; 4096 output tokens. One attempt; variants and private agents are not independent worlds.
pilot.sanitization: Positive field allowlist; no raw receipts, authorizations, local paths, ledgers, observations or model prose. Evaluator outcomes must not enter agent prompts.

hardness.limitations: High thinking. Ten worlds per 32-report arm, three attempts. Certified report cost is not proof depth.
hardness.sanitization: Positive field allowlist; no raw receipts, authorizations, local paths, ledgers, observations or model prose. Evaluator outcomes must not enter agent prompts.

flash-hard-scale.limitations: Fresh 48-world confirmation: 64 suspects, 455 interacting reports, 32768 output tokens including thinking. Reports are not certified individually necessary.
flash-hard-scale.sanitization: Positive field allowlist; no raw receipts, authorizations, local paths, ledgers, observations or model prose. Evaluator outcomes must not enter agent prompts.

flash-limits.limitations: Adaptive resource demonstration; compare matched six-world subsets only, not a new independent confirmation.
flash-limits.sanitization: Positive field allowlist; no raw receipts, authorizations, local paths, ledgers, observations or model prose. Evaluator outcomes must not enter agent prompts.

qwen-sampled-screening.limitations: 72 assigned slots, three reused pilot responses. Completion is separate from supported correctness.
qwen-sampled-screening.sanitization: Positive field allowlist; no raw receipts, authorizations, local paths, ledgers, observations or model prose. Evaluator outcomes must not enter agent prompts.

nuisance-followup.limitations: One final post-result expansion. Same protocol/settings; report initial and extension separately. Combined estimates are exploratory; six underlying worlds per stratum, two attempts per model/dose/world. Equal observed accuracy does not demonstrate equivalence. No mechanism or general robustness claim. All failures retained; no further paid calls.
nuisance-followup.sanitization: Positive outcome/usage field allowlist. No approvals, credentials, ledgers, raw receipts or provider prose. Evaluator data; never agent inputs.
